column1: # ST15. Genetic and phenotypic correlations among regional brain-age gaps and with biomarkers.
# Genetic_r/Genetic_Z/Genetic_p: LDSC cross-trait rg ('Genetic Correlation:' line; P from the separate 'P:' line, not SE).
# Genetic_p '<2.2e-308' = LDSC printed 'P: 0.' (underflow); FDR used p=5e-324 for that row (rank unchanged).
# Genetic_fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg within each family separately (inter-regional 45; external-aging 21 = Telomere Length PC1 x BAG 10 + Protein Age x BAG 10 + Protein Age x Telomere Length PC1 1).
# Phenotypic_r/Phenotypic_p: Pearson r and two-sided p on inverse-normal-transformed phenotypes ({region}_corrected_delta_age_int).
# Phenotypic_fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg within each family separately (inter-regional 45; Protein x10), same structure as Genetic_fdr. '<2.2e-308' = below double precision.
# inter-regional: both regional BAGs, British baseline N=41067; Phenotypic_p/fdr '<2.2e-308' = below double precision at this N (all 45 pairs).
# Protein Age x region: proteomic-age gap x regional BAG on the overlap sample N=5350. Telomere Length PC1 rows = NA (no individual-level telomere data supplied).
# Phenotypic source (BAG): the British-baseline N=41067 regional BAG table (UKB_PHENO_FILE in config/paths.env).

# Phenotypic source (Protein Age): ProtAge-204 age-bias-corrected proteomic-age gap (protage204_gap_int) x {region}_corrected_delta_age_int, overlap N=5350; unadjusted Pearson on inverse-normal-transformed phenotypes; BH-FDR over 10 BAG.
# Protein Age model = ProtAge-204 (Argentieri 2024 replication; repo commit eda0b4e). Genetic_p = authoritative log P. 'Protein Age x Telomere Length PC1' Phenotypic = NA.
